tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.quote: In cases other than those mentioned at paragraphs 5(i) and 5(ii) above, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of the RE.

tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.quote: However, in case of term loans, pre-payment charges, if levied by the RE, shall be based on the amount being prepaid.

tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.quote: In case of cash credit/ overdraft facilities, pre-payment charges on closure of the facility before the due date shall be levied on an amount not exceeding the sanctioned limit.
